title: Prior Late Charges and the Rate on a Shortfall Notice (Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement)
content:
**Rule.** Late charges already booked add to the late charge rate on a shortfall notice the employer is liable for: where at least 2 late charges were booked on the agreement on entry dates from which fewer than 12 whole months have passed to today, 0.5 percentage points are added; where exactly 1 was, 0.25 percentage points are added; otherwise none.

**Which late charges count?** Every late charge booked on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement in that window, on any overdue item; a whole month from an entry date is reached on the same day of the month as that entry date, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day.

**How do the counts map?**

| Late charges booked in the window | Points added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.5 |
| 1 | 0.25 |
| none | none |
